episodes.title: Yesterday's Jam
episodes.summary: In the very first episode, new recruit Jen is appointed head of the IT department, but her staff Moss and Roy soon discover that she knows nothing about computers.

episodes.title: Calamity Jen
episodes.summary: The team face their first test during Reynholm Industries' so-called 'war on stress'. The office is on fire, Roy has an attack of kleptomania, and Jen's shoes don't fit.

episodes.title: Fifty-Fifty
episodes.summary: Jen has a new admirer, but her inability to tell the truth results in humiliation. Roy decides to improve his love life by adopting a sterner attitude, and Moss recommends a romantic restaurant.

episodes.title: The Red Door
episodes.summary: What lies behind the mysterious red door in the IT department? What has happened to Moss's new mug? And why is Roy in danger of becoming known as a 'desk rabbit'?

episodes.title: The Haunting of Bill Crouse
episodes.summary: Moss goes to extraordinary lengths to help Jen escape the unwanted attention of potential suitor Bill Crouse. These lengths include Jen's untimely death...

episodes.title: Aunt Irma Visits
episodes.summary: Jen is subject to powerful mood swings around a certain time every month, and Moss and Roy develop similar symptoms. Can a big bar of chocolate, Dirty Dancing on DVD and a girly night out help?

episodes.title: The Work Outing
episodes.summary: Jen's heart soars when 'Philip from Six' visits the basement to borrow Heat, and invites her to the theatre. But her hopes of finding true love are dashed when Roy and Moss invite themselves along.

episodes.title: Return of the Golden Child
episodes.summary: Denholm's death means trouble for Jen, Roy and Moss, until support appears in the form of a mysterious, albeit libidinous, stranger.

episodes.title: Moss and the German
episodes.summary: Jen tries to escape the romantic attentions of Douglas, Roy tries to watch a film, and Moss's attempt to meet new people backfires dramatically when he answers an online ad for a cookery course.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Jen's hopes for a sophisticated dinner party are dashed when she has to invite Roy, Moss and Richmond, and, for some reason, Roy finds something hilarious about her new boyfriend's name: Peter File.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: When a bad bra makes Jen lose concentration in a board meeting, Moss overcomes his fear of ladies' underwear and invents a bra that will never fail.

episodes.title: Men Without Women
episodes.summary: Douglas hires Jen as his new PA, giving Moss and Roy free rein in the office. How will they cope without her, and how will she cope with Douglas's unwelcome advances?

episodes.title: From Hell
episodes.summary: While boss Douglas does his best to run Reynholm Industries into the ground, Jen has to deal with a builder from hell, Roy loses 20 quid and Moss learns how to stand up to ruffians.

episodes.title: Are We Not Men?
episodes.summary: A new football website allows Roy and Moss to pass as 'proper' men for a momentous couple of days. Meanwhile, Jen is trying to date a man who looks like a magician.

episodes.title: Tramps Like Us
episodes.summary: Jen, Roy and Moss find their lives moving in different directions after a disappointing settlement to a sexual harassment suit. Jen seeks pastures new, and Roy ends up out in the cold.

episodes.title: The Speech
episodes.summary: Jen makes enemies of Roy and Moss after trying to assert herself more after being named as Employee of the Month. Douglas discovers that the woman who he loves is not quite as she seems.

episodes.title: Friendface
episodes.summary: Jen introduces Roy and Moss to a new social networking website, and then finds out why some friendships are best left in the past

episodes.title: Calendar Geeks
episodes.summary: Reynholm Industries are proud to announce their first naked calendar. Enough said, probably.

episodes.title: Jen the Fredo
episodes.summary: Jen applies for the post of Entertainment Manager. When she finds out that amusing her boss Douglas's business connections has its darker side, she has to turn to Moss and Roy for help.

episodes.title: The Final Countdown
episodes.summary: Moss becomes a celebrity after he beats all the records on a popular puzzle show. Roy is mistaken for a window cleaner. Jen finds herself preoccupied with Douglas' secret meetings.

episodes.title: Something Happened
episodes.summary: Douglas becomes a Spaceologist, Roy's life is changed by a bad back, and Jen gets involved with a rock band.

episodes.title: Italian for Beginners
episodes.summary: Roy gets obsessed by his latest girlfriend's sad family history, while Jen tells an absolute whopper to get some attention.

episodes.title: Bad Boys
episodes.summary: Roy and Moss become juvenile delinquents for the day and have an uncomfortable experience at a shopping centre.

episodes.title: Reynholm vs Reynholm
episodes.summary: Douglas finds marriage agrees with him - for all of two weeks. He's then in court - defending himself - with the help of Jen, Roy, Moss and others.
